blocks.title: Empirical formula
blocks.text: Woh formula jo molecule mein har element ke atoms ka sab se chhota whole number (poore adad) wala ratio batata hai, empirical formula kehlata hai.
Maslan butane (C₄H₁₀) ka empirical formula C₂H₅ hai (4:10 ko 2 se divide karein to 2:5), aur ethanoic acid (acetic acid, C₂H₄O₂) ka CH₂O hai.
